verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships a dedicated writing-skills meta-skill (SKILL.md) that documents the TDD-style process for authoring a skill (write pressure-scenario tests, watch fail, write skill doc, watch pass, refactor) and skills are plain, git-installable markdown folders confirmed by a real runtime probe. There's also a Skills-search tool and marketplace for packaging/distributing skills, and cross-harness portability docs (porting-to-a-new-harness.md) describing how a new skill/harness integrates. missing for 10: no independent/community evidence of a user or agent actually following the meta-skill end-to-end to author a brand-new skill, and no first-party walkthrough showing the full authoring-to-packaging pipeline in one place.
